annotations.title: Manage a shared Microsoft negative keyword list

description: A SHARED negative keyword list on Microsoft Advertising — one set of exclusions reused across up to 20 campaigns. action: create (name + keywords; campaignIds attaches it straight away), add (keywords), remove (negativeKeywordIds), attach / detach (campaignIds), delete (permanent, confirm:true). Removing, detaching or deleting on a LIVE campaign lets those searches trigger paid ads again, so it needs confirm:true. Read back. Free.

action.description: create, add, remove, attach, detach or delete a shared negative keyword list

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

campaignIds.description: campaigns to attach to or detach from the list (action attach or detach)

confirm.description: true to delete the list, or to remove, detach or delete on a LIVE campaign

keywords.description: keywords for create or add: [{text, matchType}]

matchType.description: default Phrase — Microsoft has no broad negative

negativeKeywordIds.description: keyword ids to remove from the list (action remove)

name: manage_microsoft_ads_negative_keyword_list
title: Manage a shared Microsoft negative keyword list
